nodes.label: requireWizardStep Guard
nodes.rationale: Prevents deep links that skip wizard state (e.g. jumping directly to /deployment/new/summary without having selected an app first); checks useDeploymentStore().draft fields required per step and redirects back otherwise.

nodes.label: Store-to-Store Dependency (No Event Bus)
nodes.rationale: deployment.store.ts imports app.store.ts and auth.store.ts directly instead of using a central event bus; risk flagged: watch for circularity if app.store.ts were ever to reference back to deployment.store.ts.

nodes.label: In-Memory Token Handling
nodes.rationale: Any XSS payload that runs in the page would otherwise be able to exfiltrate a long-lived access token; trade-off is a hard reload loses the in-tab session, mitigated by Keycloak's SSO cookie + signinSilent re-issuing the token without a fresh login.

nodes.label: In-Memory Tokens Instead of localStorage (ADR)
nodes.rationale: useKeycloak.ts stores the OIDC access token in InMemoryWebStorage, not localStorage, because any XSS payload running in the page context could otherwise exfiltrate a long-lived access token. Accepted trade-off: a hard browser reload loses the in-tab session, cushioned by Keycloak's SSO cookie plus signinSilent reissuing the token without a fresh login screen. This is a deliberate security decision, not a gap — must not be 'fixed' by caching the token in localStorage to avoid reload loss.

nodes.label: env.ts (Runtime + Build-Time Config)
nodes.rationale: env.ts reads window.__ENV__ (runtime injection, presumably from the nginx entrypoint at container start) first, falling back to import.meta.env.VITE_* (Vite build-time) — allows config changes without a rebuild. Rest of the code should not use import.meta.env directly.
